objective.track2: Universal VLA knowledge sourcing: provenance-pinned multimodal corpora (text, code, vision, video, robotics/control, audio) ingested through typed modality adapters as frozen Zone C reference waves and domain operators; default-OFF; never benchmark-family training data; never enters score-bearing stores

mechanism.track2: typed modality adapters -> canonical real [8192,8] waves; qFHRR crystalline instillation; W_domain = normalize(mean(Psi ⊙ Psi)); 1-by-1 streaming staging with SHA-256 manifests (user preference); provenance-pinned immutable revisions

invariants: zero-pretraining invariant: no benchmark-family training; task compilation 100% online at test-time
all newly sourced data stays OUTSIDE the repository and OUTSIDE score-bearing evaluation stores until provenance + contamination review passes
Gate-4 held-out remains the zero-lineage 30-task procedural suite (seeds 21-30)
duplicate rate measured and reported per bank; dedup before calibration
episode-disjoint splits only; per-action support N_a >= 4r
one active run per GPU; preregistered envs/steps/seed/timeout/output-dir
